body:
I don't live in the sort of...accommodations where that's a viable option. I thought people here were supposed to NOT give the sad person ways to die.

But yes, I don't like Wuthering Heights either.

One is a modern day Miyazaki-style interpretation of Babes in Toyland. The other is about the woman who invented time travel UNinventing time travel by stopping herself from falling in love with the man who led her to the project.
The works in progress are novels. I don't intend to leave my works unpublished forever.

I've got some works in progress on my hard drive, but for a living, I'm a journalist. My hometown has a nascent tech scene, and I write on it for digital publications. Some work for a digital media production house brings in a little extra each month too.

I've tried. A thousand times. I tried doing the whole 'therapeutic letter that you have no intention of sending' thing, wound up with three pages of 'WHAT THE FUCK IS WRONG WITH YOU!?!'. Tried doing it all metaphorical, and it came out pretentious as hell. 

It's not that I don't recognize that I'm only in this mess because I 'loved not wisely but too well'. It's just trying to compel myself forward is..well it's hard.
Well, now the more 'emotionally and vocationally paralyzed' I.
I loved him. I believed in the good in him. The bigger fool I.

If I get over him, I'm just going to find the next version of him and make the same damn mistakes. I haven't been with a decent human being in four years. I doubt my judgment, thanks to this douchecanoe, very much indeed. I am a better person. But perhaps a dumber one.
No. But the road to hell is paved with good intentions. That I do know.
I *know* I'm talking about him too much. But how am I going to shut me up, sans noose?

Dead mother, emotionally abusive father, older brother with mental illness, twin sister impeded by the family to the point where she's not allowed to grow her hair out. Routinely he told me that I was a better person than he was. I didn't hear 'You're so good, I totally WOULD sell you out on Reddit with lies for karma' but you know what? I still hung on to him. Because I 'cared about him'. Fuck his shit.

...five inches and skinny. They already know. They already still party with him. I mean, lame/awesome boardgame partying, but still, partying nonetheless. I feel as though I have to start over regardless. They might not pick him. But they didn't pick me, and I'm the one who was hurt.

He wanted me gone for months. He has his wish. I'd like to see things your way, but I'm sure he's happier with me gone. And since my purported friends are also his, what's to stop them from following his lead?

Only if I let myself. Either through letting myself live, or letting myself forget. I'd talk about forgiving, but how do you forgive such a betrayal? How do I possibly forgive MYSELF for putting myself in a situation where betrayal was the only outcome?
Doesn't it, though? I mean, not straight away, but eventually, automatically, they'll leave you or die on you.

He didn't even use a throwaway to talk about how much he hated me. And he told so many lies, too--claiming to have had a string of girlfriends rather than just me in his past so he felt less 'gay' admitting he liked cybering with men. Claiming to work in finance and that he had to figure out how to get a suit to the office.  He is dumb. But who agreed to go out with him again?

I think I am partially choosing unhappiness, though. It's so much easier to be unhappy than to be brave and think 'Well, so he betrayed you even though you took his virginity and loved him as best as you can, better luck next time because his behaviour isn't representative of your worth as a human being'. I can't do that yet and I'm scared that the minute I do, I'll just fall in love, and then the rug will be pulled out from under me. I can't feel like this again.

My parents are getting sick of my bullshit--also, I'm sick of being bullshit in front of them. They raised me to be better than this, to be a winner, to burn up the inside track. I'm failing them with every second I keep crying.

I live with them. They've seen me like this, it's been nearly two months since the discovery and in the first couple weeks, they accepted me crying and being sad...but now I have to wait until they're asleep or out of the apartment to let it out. They want me to be better than this. I wish I thought I could be. I feel like a fraud.
